scope: Guarded app-only installation, flash device-checksum verification, and serial boot-health evidence for units A and B. Multiplayer runtime and gameplay acceptance are separate and remain pending in this record.
selected_scope:
0.69 Tab5 app-only debug successor to the exact installed 0.68 image on backed-up units A/ST7121 and B/ST7123.
Promotes reviewed protocol-8 recent Doom world checkpoint transfer/restore plus bounded history suffix for fresh/returning guests while the running host continues; finite preallocated PSRAM storage, transfer leases/timeouts and failure rejection remain explicit. Cold supported Doom Arena state only; teardown reboot limitation and heard-audio acceptance remain pending. Physical join/leave/rejoin, capture pause, transfer latency and 25 FPS requested floor/30 FPS repository release floor remain to be measured.
Promotes reviewed OS-owned bounded native-game video presenter worker with two immutable PSRAM buffers, backend metrics, first-frame fence and joined teardown. All nine native multiplayer games require paired device tests and measured cadence/audio/exit evidence.
Uses exact reviewed combined console_os_main.c rather than either standalone candidate. Promotion receipt: build-host/tab5-multiplayer-hardware/promote-069/transactions/root-promotion-v1/receipt.json. Changes 3 version declarations to 0.69 and six version-dependent golden hash constants in one host-test file. Host-test SHA provider changes STATIC to OBJECT so weak references receive the real provider consistently; firmware code is unaffected by this test-only amendment.
Retains 0.68 Doom indexed/BSP parity optimizations, storage range reads, neutral-gamepad broker and all inherited unit/recovery/content/peripheral guards. No SD wipe, package changes, external publication or toolchain upgrades. Preserves preexisting global provenance failure for tracked Pure Hades v0.6 WAD and inherited signed-shift UBSan finding as separate unresolved historical gates.
